description:
Delete the profile-lifecycle torn-tail marker and the finalizer code that wrote and ordered it, which no reader consults any more.

## Background

The profile-lifecycle event carries `isolated_torn_tail` (`crates/jit/src/domain/types.rs:1585,1963`, catalog sample `domain/event_catalog.rs:437`). The finalizer stamps it and moves the marker to the first appended line over a torn tail (`repository_state/mutation.rs:1195-1235`), detects the tail with `prefix_has_torn_tail` (`:606`, re-exported at `repository_state/mod.rs:102`, tested at `:2426`) and declares `MutationError::UncertifiedTornTail` (`:477`). No reader consults the marker, and no mutation refuses an unterminated tail. Tests naming the marker: `mutation.rs:2532-2580`, `commands/profile.rs:5219-5240,6365-6395`, `storage/repository_state_store_tests.rs`. No line of this repository's event log carries the field.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `ProfileLifecycle.isolated_torn_tail`, the finalizer's marker stamping and reordering, `prefix_has_torn_tail` and `UncertifiedTornTail` no longer exist, and no test names them.
- [hard] REQ-02: The generated event reference and this repository's event log decode and re-serialize unchanged.

## Notes

- Written against the code as it stands after the semantic-types epic (2195c98f): issue ids are `IssueId`, gate-run ids `GateRunId`, gate keys `GateKey`, lease ids `LeaseId`, events are an `Event` envelope around a tagged `EventBody`, and record paths come from `VirtualPath` constructors. Line citations name current code, which that epic retypes.
title: The profile torn-tail marker is gone
